name: Hayman's London Dry Gin
production: Botanicals steeped in wheat spirit for a full day before distillation (two-day process)
history: 1863 | Family founder, a pharmacist, bought a gin rectifying business on Cale Street, Chelsea
1969 | Christopher Hayman joined the family business
2023 | 160 years as a family gin distiller
nose: Juniper and fresh citrus in balance
finish: Citrus and spice giving way to earthy notes
expressions: Hayman's Royal Dock Gin | Navy Strength
serve_official: Hayman's G&T with classic tonic and a lemon peel twist; also a Martini
notes: Run by 5th-generation siblings James and Miranda Hayman with father Christopher. Backlog year 2004 not confirmed [cần kiểm tra].
